base: The exact same character as the reference images: the Honduras Secreta scarlet macaw mascot (Pixar-quality 3D, red body, yellow and blue wings, white face patch, curved pale beak, wearing the same beige bucket hat with the same 'Honduras Secreta' patch). Keep identical proportions, colors and hat. Setting: a dark, elegant, empty theater stage; a vintage chrome broadcast microphone on a stand; a small dark wooden lectern. Cinematic lighting with a single dramatic top spotlight cutting through haze, deep blacks, rich colors, shallow depth of field, shot on ARRI Alexa with anamorphic lens, film grain. Vertical 9:16. No text other than the hat patch, no watermark.
tomas: Wide shot from the back of the dark theater: the macaw stands alone on the lectern at center stage, tiny in the frame, inside a cone of white spotlight with volumetric haze, rows of empty seats silhouetted in the foreground, epic loneliness.

Medium close-up, straight on: the macaw stands behind the vintage microphone, beak slightly open as if about to speak, intense determined eyes looking directly into the camera, spotlight from above sculpting the feathers, background falls into darkness. Face clearly visible and well lit.

Extreme close-up: the macaw's colorful wing feathers firmly grabbing the chrome microphone stand and pulling the microphone up toward its beak, chrome reflections, dust particles in the spotlight, dramatic.

Low-angle heroic shot from below the lectern: the macaw at the microphone with wings slightly spread, strong backlight spotlight creating a glowing rim halo around its feathers and hat, haze rays, powerful and inspiring, beak open speaking.
Side profile: the macaw in near silhouette against haze lit from behind, head slightly lowered in thought next to the microphone, quiet and melancholic, warm rim light on the beak edge.

Close-up three-quarter angle: the macaw speaking passionately into the microphone, the stage light has turned warm golden sunset orange, a tear-like glint in its eye, emotional and strong, beak open mid-word. Face clearly visible.
Medium shot: the macaw lowering the microphone with one wing and smiling warmly at the camera, soft warm golden light filling the stage, hopeful and peaceful.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind the macaw at the microphone, looking out at a dark audience where dozens of smartphone screens glow cold blue in the darkness, ominous.
